description: This file defines a helper class for creating and manipulating DateTime objects within a Calendar synchronization context in SuiteCRM. It provides a method to create DateTime instances from various input formats such as strings, timestamps, or existing DateTime objects, with internal logic to handle timezone-aware strings and milliseconds timestamps.

classes.name: DateTimeHelper
classes.description: A helper class for creating and managing PHP DateTime instances in the context of Calendar synchronization.

methods.name: createDateTime
methods.description: Creates a DateTime object from various input types, including DateTime, string, integer timestamp (milliseconds), or null. Handles timezone-aware strings and converts millisecond timestamps to seconds.

methods.name: isTimezoneAwareString
methods.description: Checks whether a date string contains explicit timezone information based on regex pattern matching.
